## What this page explains

The CVD report listings refresh automatically when Quarto renders the website. **No separate report-listing action is required.**

This page is technical reference material for maintaining or checking the listing definitions and generated report landing pages.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="No separate refresh action"}
Complete the rolling, annual or one-off report publication route, then follow the normal website render and deployment process. Quarto discovers the new published landing page automatically.
:::

## Listings and discovery rules

| File | What Quarto discovers |
|---|---|
| `site/surveillance/cvd/index.qmd` | `reports/updates/*/index.qmd`, `reports/annual/*/index.qmd`, `reports/briefings/*/index.qmd` and `reports/studies/*/index.qmd`. This creates **CVD Reports and Studies**. |
| `site/news/index.qmd` | `../surveillance/*/reports/*/*/index.qmd`. This creates **Latest Surveillance Outputs**. |

Both listings sort published landing pages by `date` in descending order. The CVD listing uses a table; Latest Surveillance Outputs uses cards.

## Required landing-page fields

Published report landing pages provide fields such as:

```yaml
title: "Reader-facing title"
description: "Short public description"
date: YYYY-MM-DD
date-modified: YYYY-MM-DD
report-id: stable_versioned_identifier
report-type: Annual report
report-version: v1
image: /assets/images/listings/example.webp
image-alt: Short image description.
categories:
  - CVD
```

Report-specific fields may also identify the coverage period, source data releases, study ID or related report. Keep machine identifiers stable and use ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` dates.

The date is the publication date used for listing order; it does not rename the surveillance year covered by a report.

## Listing-image pool and rotation

The rolling-update, annual-report and one-off-report builders use
`scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_listing_images.do` to select an image for a
new page. The active pool and its alternative text are maintained in
`site/assets/images/listings/listing-images.csv`; do not edit the Stata helper
to add or withdraw an image.

At the start of every complete Quarto render,
`site/scripts/refresh_report_listing_images.py` reads that catalogue and
deterministically assigns images across all published CVD report pages, newest
first. This corrects historical repetitions as well as allocating new reports.
The same reports and catalogue always produce the same allocation; images do
not change randomly from one render to the next.

### Maintain the image pool

1. Place a landscape WebP file in `site/assets/images/listings/`.
2. Add one row to `listing-images.csv`: the filename, a short accurate image
   description, and `yes` in the `active` column.
3. Run a complete local Quarto render and check the CVD reports and Latest
   Surveillance Outputs pages.

To withdraw an image, change its `active` value to `no`. Leave the file in the
folder so that repository history remains complete. The render stops with a
plain-language message if fewer than six active images are available for the
six Latest Surveillance Output cards.

The image refresh changes only the public landing-page `image` and `image-alt`
metadata. It does not change report text, files, dates, identities, approval
records or analytical results. Review the resulting Git changes before commit;
do not alter the generated assignments by hand.

## Checks during normal website review

After the normal site render, check both listings as part of website review:

- the report appears once and in the expected date order;
- title, description, report type, image, alternative text and categories are correct;
- the listed landing page opens; and
- every PDF and public data link works.

## If a listing is wrong

| Situation | What to check |
|---|---|
| Report is missing | The published folder matches a discovery pattern, the file is named `index.qmd`, and its YAML has valid delimiters and `date`. |
| Order is wrong | `date` is valid ISO format and records the intended publication date. |
| Report appears twice | Two landing pages may match the discovery patterns. Remove the unintended published copy through the controlled report route. |
| Card or table row is incomplete | Check `title`, `description`, `image` and `image-alt` in the generated landing page. |
| PDF link fails | Return to the report publication output mapping. Do not create an extra manually linked copy. |

The listings are indexes only. They do not approve, copy or transform reports.
